q: How do I count diesel bought for cash without a GST invoice?
title: Cash diesel without a GST invoice
short: Count it from the pump receipt or a fuel log: litres × 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Mark it as lower quality evidence than an invoice. Moving regular purchases to invoices or a fuel card makes the figure checkable.
audience: MSMEs buying diesel for generators and vehicles in cash

ul: Pump receipt with date, litres and amount.
A log of litres issued to each generator or vehicle.
Stock at the start and end of the month, if you store diesel.

p: Estimate from amount paid ÷ the pump price on that date, and label it an estimate.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so each figure shows the quantity, factor and document it came from.
